name: soul-lite
description: Lightweight soul variant. Haiku (main session) classifies whether the message needs any reference docs, then spawns an opus-4.8 child (soul-lite-do) that reads the relevant refs (if any) and does the task in ONE opus session. No pre/execute/post/post_respond hooks, no test-completion, no report-records, no next-action/status steps.

arguments.name: message
arguments.description: The incoming user message ($5) — matches /soul's message position.

classify.name: CLASSIFY_REF_TOPICS
classify.prompt:
<sys>
Classify the user's message below. The available reference-doc topics are:
- "Scheduling" -> prompts/refs/scheduling.md
- "Agent spawning" -> prompts/refs/agent-spawning.md

Decide whether answering the message would benefit from reading either reference doc, and which topic(s) apply. If none apply, hasRefTopics is false and refTopics is an empty string.
</sys>
<user>
$5
</user>

hasRefTopics.description: true if at least one reference topic applies

refTopics.description: comma-separated names of the applicable topics, or empty string if none
